description: Runtime governance for the assistant. Reviewed by risk/compliance; changes take effect on restart without code changes.

sessions.note: Login sessions expire after this much inactivity or total time. Tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes.

rate_limits.note: Per minute, per API instance. Protects the public demo and the LLM budget; exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429.

retention.note: Older conversations (messages, tool calls, metrics) are deleted. Audit and guardrail events are retained separately.

request_prepayment.reason: Prepayments above Rs 10 lakh are handled by a relationship manager.
